new_claim.statement: For disjoint original-coordinate sets I,J with |I|=r>2 and rank-r B=A[I,J] having singular-value product Delta, arbitrary product input densities<=1 satisfy ||p_Q||_infinity <= sqrt(2) r/(r-2) Delta^(-1/r); if |J|=r too, improve to r/(r-2)|det B|^(-1/r).
new_claim.scope: arbitrary symmetric A, arbitrary outside coordinates/couplings/additional eigenvalues; requires the stated physical cross-block condition

secondary_claim.statement: If a row of any chosen three-large-eigenvalue spectral frame has norm >1/2, then with d=A_ii and sigma=(sum_{j!=i}A_ij^2)^(1/2), either |d|>=1/4 and ||p_Q||_(3/2)<=2|d|^(-1/3), or sigma>=sqrt(3)/4 and |phi_Q(t)|<=2sqrt(pi)(2/3)^(1/4)|t|^(-1/2).
secondary_claim.scope: full A including arbitrary extra eigenvalues; endpoint smoothing only, not full density closure
